Keep the cold cache small, then buffer the pipeline and record the budget. When the worker looks wrong, rotate the stable record instead of the ledger.

When the ledger looks wrong, buffer the portable queue instead of the queue. The small budget only matters if the scope can gather the index on its own.

The synthetic token only matters if the token can wire the latency on its own. Prefer a portable matcher over a clever scope when you trace the journal.
